result:
I’d remove the ability to make “other people” feel less real than oneself.

Not by forcing kindness, but by making it impossible to genuinely believe strangers are less alive, less complex, or less deserving of safety than the people you love. Most cruelty, indifference, and systemic harm would have a much harder time surviving that.
